description: This Zenodo collection assembles Vietnamese population, GDP, passenger and freight activity, vehicle stock, energy intensity, load capacity and carbon factors for transport-energy modelling. The researchers distinguish nine modes, including motorcycles, buses, trucks, rail, inland waterway vessels, maritime shipping and aviation, and nine fuels from petrol to electricity, hydrogen and ammonia. The current public record lists mode and factor CSVs, a processing workbook, quality workbook and README under CC BY 4.0. The Data in Brief article cites an earlier Zenodo record whose landing now redirects to this later DOI; both identify the same compilation. Coverage is national, mostly assembled from secondary statistics, not route-level observations or a live timetable. Source years and units need harmonization before combining modes or projecting emissions. A reviewer-assessed use is setting national transport-demand and fuel-transition assumptions in scenario simulations. model-matsim is a related transport simulator, but no conversion of annual aggregates into agent trips was verified. No CSV, workbook or processing formula was downloaded.
